questions.question: At Potchefstroom Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
questions.explanation: Lizri de Villiers holds it with 15, a joint record shared with Nthabiseng Nini.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Tuskers or Limpopo Lillies?
At which ground did Cobras record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Recreation Ground — largest win by runs of 109, against Badgers on 2024/12/15.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 50+ Scores' in the 19/20 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Tazmin Brits holds it, with a total of 3.

questions.question: At which ground did Verunissa Reddy record their career-best innings (67, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Potchefstroom Oval, against Badgers on 2026/02/21.

questions.question: Laura Wolvaardt became the first South African woman to reach 5,000 ODI runs. In how many innings did she reach the milestone, the second-fastest ever?
questions.explanation: Wolvaardt reached 5,000 ODI runs in 117 innings, second only to India's Smriti Mandhana (112 innings).
